prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize energy for early morning 2-hour cycling ride with high intensity intervals

solution_criteria: Includes pre-ride meal (1-2 hours before) with easily digestible carbs and moderate protein
Includes mid-ride nutrition strategy for sustained energy during 2-hour effort
Includes post-ride recovery meal with carbs and protein for muscle repair
Plan is compact and fits within one day format
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport with specific timing constraints (cyclist with early morning ride) requiring pre-workout fueling, mid-activity nutrition, and post-workout recovery optimization

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with high carbohydrate intake for sustained energy and recovery

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals plus pre/post-training nutrition
Emphasizes carbohydrates as primary macronutrient (55-65% of calories) with adequate protein for recovery
Includes timing recommendations aligned with training schedule
Provides realistic, compact format suitable for a single day
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-performance endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and sustained energy throughout training and recovery

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day
Each meal contains at least 30g of protein with total daily protein ≥2.5g per kg bodyweight (212.5g minimum)
Total daily calories support muscle building for an 85kg strength athlete (approximately 3000-3500 calories)
Meal plan is presented in compact, easy-to-read format suitable for quick reference
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
